name: creations_deliver
description: Completed creation in an editor-native format (ProRes/DNxHR/hvc1 video, 16-bit PNG/TIFF or layered PSD image, WAV audio), optionally capped at 720p/1080p for video. Video and audio renders carry provenance metadata (creation id, model, prompt, date). Free; the render runs once and is stored. `ready` → download `url`; `processing` → call again after `poll_after_seconds`; `failed` → read `reason`, pass `retry=true` only if it can succeed.

maxHeight.description: Video profiles only: cap the frame height (720 or 1080), downscaling a larger source and leaving a smaller one alone. Omit for the source size. Each cap is its own stored render.

profile.description: Video: prores_422hq, prores_4444 (alpha), dnxhr_hq, hevc_hvc1, h264, png_sequence (zip). Image: png16, tiff16, psd_layers (Auto Layers output only). Audio: wav_48k, mp3.

retry.description: Re-run a render that previously failed.
